name: shop-siren~p2
task: Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The hard Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) matches the task wording 'Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off' — 'each time' is a Response cue with siren_ringing as trigger and switch_toggled (the only way to turn the siren off) as consequent. Because siren_ringing is a lasting condition that ends exactly when the switch is toggled, the obligation owed on every ringing step is closed by that toggle, so satisfying the clause is precisely turning the siren off after each ring; it fails only if the episode ends mid-ring, which is a genuine task failure. The rule-only warning is valid: 'turn it off' is the consequent of the each-time condition, not an unconditional goal, so the empty FINAL_STATES is correct.

texts: Each time the siren is ringing, the agent toggles the siren switch.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u1
(u1, switch_toggled) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled, u1) -> -1
(u1, switch_toggled, u0) -> 1
